content.worksheet_title: LITERACY & VOCABULARY — The Toolbelt in Action
content.guia_header: MGV · Guía 1 · The Visual Communicator · Nivel A1.1 · Sesión 2 (parte 2)

bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_en: You read about the 20 words. Now you own them. In this session you spell them, see them, say them, sort them and use them. Laura builds her own Studio Glossary. Build yours.
bilingual_instruction_block.main_message_es_cursiva: Leíste sobre las 20 palabras. Ahora son tuyas. En esta sesión las deletreas, las ves, las dices, las clasificas y las usas. Laura construye su propio Glosario del Estudio. Construye el tuyo.

archetype_A_PHONICS_SPELLING.name_en: PHONICS & SPELLING — Mirror Talking + Splat! + Sound Sorting
archetype_A_PHONICS_SPELLING.name_es: FONÉTICA Y DELETREO — Habla al Espejo + ¡Splat! + Clasificación Sonora
selected_techniques: Splat! (reconocimiento rápido de palabras en tablero)
archetype_A_PHONICS_SPELLING.rationale_a11: Fonética básica es cimiento A1.1. Los 20 términos contienen fonemas problemáticos para hispanohablantes: /θ/ (font/serif no lo tienen pero CMYK y canvas sí tienen /æ/), /ɪ/ vs /i:/ (serif/line), /oʊ/ (bold/logo), /ʊ/ vs /uː/ (cool). Los tres técnicas cubren producción, reconocimiento y discriminación.

activity_a1_mirror_talking.title_en: MIRROR TALKING — Watch Your Own Mouth
activity_a1_mirror_talking.title_es: HABLA AL ESPEJO — Observa Tu Propia Boca
activity_a1_mirror_talking.mode: pairs with small mirror (or smartphone front camera)
activity_a1_mirror_talking.instruction_en: With a mirror or selfie camera, say each word SLOWLY 3 times. Watch your lips. Compare with your partner.
activity_a1_mirror_talking.instruction_es_cursiva: Con un espejo o cámara selfie, di cada palabra LENTAMENTE 3 veces. Observa tus labios. Compara con tu compañero.

target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_en: Round lips for /ɒ/. Tongue tip down for /f/.
target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_es_cursiva: Labios redondos para /ɒ/. Punta de lengua abajo para /f/.

target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_en: Open mouth on /oʊ/. Lips together for /b/. Tongue up for /ld/.
target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_es_cursiva: Boca abierta en /oʊ/. Labios juntos para /b/. Lengua arriba para /ld/.

target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_en: Lips pushed forward like whistle for /uː/. Long sound.
target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_es_cursiva: Labios hacia adelante como silbido para /uː/. Sonido largo.

target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_en: Wide lips /w/, jaw down for /ɔːr/, lips together /m/.
target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_es_cursiva: Labios anchos /w/, mandíbula abajo para /ɔːr/, labios juntos /m/.

target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_en: /s/ sharp. /eɪ/ long. /v/ lower lip on upper teeth.
target_words_with_mouth_cues.cue_es_cursiva: /s/ agudo. /eɪ/ largo. /v/ labio inferior sobre dientes superiores.

partner_check.instruction_en: Watch your partner say the word. Can you SEE the correct mouth shape?

activity_a2_splat.mode: whole class · instructor with flyswatter or pointer
activity_a2_splat.instruction_en: All 20 Toolbelt words are scattered on the board. Instructor says a definition. First student to SPLAT the correct word wins a point.
activity_a2_splat.instruction_es_cursiva: Las 20 palabras del Toolbelt están dispersas en el tablero. El instructor da una definición. El primer estudiante en hacer SPLAT en la palabra correcta gana un punto.
activity_a2_splat.board_setup: Print 20 words on large paper cards, arrange randomly on the board or wall.

sample_definitions_and_answers.def_en: A font with small lines at the ends of letters.
The work area in design software.
A color system for printing: Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Key.
A transparent level on top of the canvas.
A small symbol for a brand.
A pattern of lines to organize a design.

activity_a2_splat.rotation_rule: After each round, the pointer passes to the next student (so shy learners also splat).

activity_a3_sound_sorting.title_en: SOUND SORTING — Group by Stressed Syllable
activity_a3_sound_sorting.title_es: CLASIFICACIÓN SONORA — Agrupar por Sílaba Tónica
activity_a3_sound_sorting.instruction_en: Classify the 20 words into 3 groups: 1 syllable · 2 syllables · 3+ syllables. Circle the stressed syllable.
activity_a3_sound_sorting.instruction_es_cursiva: Clasifica las 20 palabras en 3 grupos: 1 sílaba · 2 sílabas · 3+ sílabas. Encierra en círculo la sílaba tónica.

sample_rows.1_syl: font, bold, warm, cool, line, shape, grid, save, print
sample_rows.2_syl: SE-rif, CAN-vas, LAY-er, TOOL-bar, PEN-cil, LO-go, POS-ter, O-pen

activity_a3_sound_sorting.micro_capsula_tip: > 🎤 **Stress Rule:** In English, the stressed syllable is LONGER and LOUDER. If you stress the wrong syllable, people don't understand. (*En inglés, la sílaba tónica es MÁS LARGA y MÁS FUERTE. Si acentúas mal, no te entienden.*)

archetype_B_VOCABULARY_DEVELOPMENT.name_en: VOCABULARY DEVELOPMENT — Semantic Mapping + Word Wall + Self-Collection
archetype_B_VOCABULARY_DEVELOPMENT.name_es: DESARROLLO DE VOCABULARIO — Mapeo Semántico + Muro de Palabras + Auto-Colección
archetype_B_VOCABULARY_DEVELOPMENT.actua_como: Vocabulary Development Coach & Semantic Network Specialist
selected_techniques: Vocabulary Self-Collection Strategy (VSS — learners add their own words)
archetype_B_VOCABULARY_DEVELOPMENT.rationale_a11: La organización semántica ancla la retención. El muro de palabras mantiene exposición continua (factor Salience de SUCCESS). VSS da ownership — los aprendices detectan qué palabras les faltan.

activity_b1_semantic_mapping.mode: groups of 4 with large poster paper
activity_b1_semantic_mapping.instruction_en: Draw a big circle 'GRAPHIC DESIGN' in the center. Add 5 branches (5 categories). On each branch, add the 4 terms. For each term, add: a drawing + a synonym or related word.
activity_b1_semantic_mapping.instruction_es_cursiva: Dibuja un gran círculo 'DISEÑO GRÁFICO' en el centro. Añade 5 ramas (5 categorías). En cada rama, añade los 4 términos. Para cada término, añade: un dibujo + un sinónimo o palabra relacionada.
activity_b1_semantic_mapping.deliverable: 1 poster per group — stays on classroom wall for all subsequent sessions (becomes WORD WALL)

activity_b2_word_wall.instruction_en: Select the BEST semantic map poster. Hang it on the wall. It becomes THE Word Wall for Sessions 3-8.
activity_b2_word_wall.instruction_es_cursiva: Selecciona el MEJOR cartel. Cuélgalo en la pared. Se convierte en EL Muro de Palabras para las Sesiones 3-8.
activity_b2_word_wall.ongoing_rule_en: Every session, anyone can add a NEW related word to the Word Wall. Use a yellow sticky note.
activity_b2_word_wall.ongoing_rule_es_cursiva: Cada sesión, cualquiera puede agregar una nueva palabra relacionada al Muro. Usa una nota adhesiva amarilla.
activity_b2_word_wall.sena_salience_factor_applied: La exposición permanente activa el factor Salience de SUCCESS §5.10

activity_b3_vocabulary_self_collection.title_es: MI CUADERNO DE VOCABULARIO — Toolbelt Personal
activity_b3_vocabulary_self_collection.instruction_en: Create your personal Vocabulary Notebook. Copy the 20 Toolbelt terms. Then ADD 5 NEW words you found in the Master Anchor Text (or in the reading) that are NOT in the Toolbelt but you want to learn.
activity_b3_vocabulary_self_collection.instruction_es_cursiva: Crea tu Cuaderno de Vocabulario personal. Copia los 20 términos. Luego AÑADE 5 palabras NUEVAS que encontraste en el texto que NO están en el Toolbelt pero quieres aprender.
activity_b3_vocabulary_self_collection.self_selected_5_words_rationale: Personal ownership = retention. A1.1 learners remember words they CHOSE 3x better than words assigned.
activity_b3_vocabulary_self_collection.laura_studio_glossary_reference: Laura's Studio Glossary (our reference): Laura's notebook has 800+ entries after 12 years. Start with your 25.

archetype_C_READING_FLUENCY.name_en: READING FLUENCY — Reader's Theater + Cloze + Repeated Reading
archetype_C_READING_FLUENCY.name_es: FLUIDEZ LECTORA — Teatro del Lector + Cloze + Lectura Repetida
archetype_C_READING_FLUENCY.rationale_a11: Fluidez A1.1 = velocidad + precisión + prosodia básica. Reader's Theater da motivación emocional. Cloze verifica microestructura. Repeated Reading construye automaticidad.

activity_c1_readers_theater.title_es: TEATRO DEL LECTOR — Email de Andrés y Sophia
activity_c1_readers_theater.instruction_en: Distribute roles: NARRATOR (reads action) + ANDRÉS (reads dialogue) + SOPHIA (reads email). Rehearse once. Perform to the group.
activity_c1_readers_theater.instruction_es_cursiva: Distribuye roles: NARRADOR (lee acción) + ANDRÉS (lee diálogo) + SOPHIA (lee email). Ensaya una vez. Presenta al grupo.

script.line_en: Monday morning. Andrés is at his desk. His phone rings.
Hi Andrés. This is Sophia. I am sending the brief now. Please read it.
Andrés opens the email. He reads Sophia's words.
We need a new logo. Use a serif font in bold. Warm colors only. No cool colors. The deadline is Friday.
Serif? What is serif? I don't know serif. Laura is in a meeting. OK. Google time.
Andrés opens Creative Bloq. He reads the article. Now he understands. Sophia wants serif. The bakery is traditional. Perfect match.
OK. Serif. Warm colors. Bakery. I can do this.

performance_rubric: Pronunciation of target words: font, serif, warm, cool, bold, bakery
Emotion: Andrés panics then finds solution
Pace: slow enough to be understood

activity_c2_cloze.instruction_en: Complete the passage with the missing Toolbelt words. Some words appear twice.
activity_c2_cloze.instruction_es_cursiva: Completa el pasaje con las palabras faltantes del Toolbelt. Algunas aparecen dos veces.
activity_c2_cloze.cloze_passage_en: Andrés opens his _________ (1). He clicks on the _________ (2). He does not know the word '_________' (3). He opens Creative Bloq. A _________ (3) font has small _________ (4) at the ends of letters. Arial is a _________ (5) font. Sophia wants a _________ (6) and a _________ (7). She asks for _________ (8) colors like red and orange. Andrés adds a _________ (9) in Canva. He types in _________ (10) style. He _________ (11) the file.

maze_variant_for_lower_a11.note: If Cloze is too hard, provide MAZE: 3 options per gap

activity_c3_repeated_reading.instruction_en: Choose ONE paragraph of the Master Anchor Text. Read it aloud 3 times. Your partner times each reading. Goal: 2nd reading 10% faster, 3rd reading 20% faster — WITHOUT errors.
activity_c3_repeated_reading.instruction_es_cursiva: Elige UN párrafo del texto ancla. Léelo en voz alta 3 veces. Tu compañero cronometra cada lectura. Meta: 2da lectura 10% más rápida, 3ra 20% más rápida — SIN errores.

archetype_D_WRITING_SCAFFOLDING.name_en: WRITING SCAFFOLDING — LEA + Dialogue Journal + Guided Writing
archetype_D_WRITING_SCAFFOLDING.name_es: ANDAMIAJE DE ESCRITURA — LEA + Diario Dialógico + Escritura Guiada
archetype_D_WRITING_SCAFFOLDING.actua_como: Writing Scaffold Designer & Language Experience Approach Specialist
archetype_D_WRITING_SCAFFOLDING.rationale_a11: A1.1 no escribe libre — escribe con andamios. LEA conecta oralidad con escritura. Dialogue Journal baja la ansiedad con exchange corto. Guided Writing con frames garantiza precisión.

activity_d1_lea.instruction_en: Student A says 2-3 sentences about Andrés's day (in simple English). Student B writes EXACTLY what A says. Then swap.
activity_d1_lea.instruction_es_cursiva: A dice 2-3 oraciones sobre el día de Andrés (en inglés simple). B escribe EXACTAMENTE lo que A dice. Luego intercambien.

example_exchange.student_a_says: Andrés opens the email. He reads Sophia's words. He is nervous.
example_exchange.student_b_writes: Andrés opens the email. He reads Sophia's words. He is nervous.
example_exchange.correction_together: If there's an error (e.g., 'He is nervous' → 'He is nerves'), correct together. Write the corrected version.

activity_d1_lea.lea_principle: Language Experience = the learner's own speech becomes their reading text. High transfer, high ownership.

activity_d2_dialogue_journal.instruction_en: Write 3-4 sentences to Andrés. Give him advice or ask a question. Use any 5 Toolbelt words. The instructor reads and responds in writing.
activity_d2_dialogue_journal.instruction_es_cursiva: Escribe 3-4 oraciones a Andrés. Dale un consejo o hazle una pregunta. Usa 5 palabras del Toolbelt. El instructor lee y responde por escrito.
activity_d2_dialogue_journal.example_student_entry: Hi Andrés. I understand your problem. Use a serif font. Use warm colors. Save the logo. Good luck!
activity_d2_dialogue_journal.example_instructor_response: Great advice! I like 'save the logo.' One question: what color is 'warm' for you? Red? Orange?
activity_d2_dialogue_journal.ongoing_rule: This journal continues across S3-S7. Each session adds one entry. Focus on Toolbelt reuse.

activity_d3_guided_writing.title_es: ESCRITURA GUIADA — Memo de Decisión de Diseño
activity_d3_guided_writing.instruction_en: Fill the frame. Write your own design decision memo (Andrés-style).
activity_d3_guided_writing.instruction_es_cursiva: Llena el marco. Escribe tu propio memo de decisión de diseño (estilo Andrés).

frame.frame: The client wants a __________ (type of business).
I will use a __________ (serif / sans-serif) font because __________.
I will use __________ (warm / cool) colors because __________.
I will save the file as a __________ (logo / poster).

archetype_E_INTERACTIVE_LITERACY.name_en: INTERACTIVE LITERACY — Jigsaw Reading + Read-Pair-Share + Info Gap
archetype_E_INTERACTIVE_LITERACY.name_es: LITERACIDAD INTERACTIVA — Jigsaw Reading + Lee-Pareja-Comparte + Info Gap
archetype_E_INTERACTIVE_LITERACY.actua_como: Interactive Literacy Designer & Social Reading Specialist
archetype_E_INTERACTIVE_LITERACY.rationale_a11: Estos 3 conectan literacidad con oralidad en bucles cortos. Jigsaw ya está montado en PM-2.3; se activa. Read-Pair-Share ≤5 min baja ansiedad. Vocab Info Gap crea necesidad comunicativa.

activity_e1_jigsaw_reading.title_en: JIGSAW READING — Expert Category Deep Dive
activity_e1_jigsaw_reading.title_es: JIGSAW READING — Inmersión Experta por Categoría
activity_e1_jigsaw_reading.mode: reusing Jigsaw groups from PM-2.3 Archetype D
activity_e1_jigsaw_reading.instruction_en: Expert groups now READ an additional micro-article about their category (1 paragraph each). Summarize in 2 sentences for Home Group.
activity_e1_jigsaw_reading.instruction_es_cursiva: Grupos expertos ahora LEEN un micro-artículo adicional sobre su categoría (1 párrafo cada uno). Resumen en 2 oraciones para Grupo Base.

micro_articles_by_category.micro_article_en: Fonts have personality. Serif fonts feel classic. Sans-serif fonts feel modern. Bold fonts feel strong. Italic fonts feel elegant. Choose the font that fits the message.
Colors create emotion. Warm colors (red, orange, yellow) feel active and hungry. Cool colors (blue, green, purple) feel calm and trustworthy. CMYK is for print. RGB is for screens.
Good design uses shapes well. Lines divide space. Shapes organize content. Grids keep everything aligned. Balance makes the design feel stable and professional.
Designers use software. Canva is easy. Photoshop is powerful. Every tool has a canvas, layers, and a toolbar. The pencil tool is for drawing. Layers keep elements separate.
Designers make products. A logo is a brand's face. A poster promotes an event. Every product follows a workflow: open the software, create, save the file, and send it to the client.

activity_e2_read_pair_share.instruction_en: Step 1: Read the Master Anchor Text silently for 2 minutes. Step 2: Choose ONE sentence you LIKE. Step 3: Share with your partner: 'I like this sentence because...'
activity_e2_read_pair_share.instruction_es_cursiva: Paso 1: Lee el texto en silencio 2 minutos. Paso 2: Elige UNA oración que te GUSTE. Paso 3: Comparte con tu compañero: 'Me gusta esta oración porque...'
activity_e2_read_pair_share.sentence_frame_for_step_3: I like the sentence '___________' because it uses ___________ (Toolbelt word) and it means ___________.

activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.title_en: VOCABULARY INFO GAP — Fill Each Other's Toolbelt
activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.title_es: INFO GAP DE VOCABULARIO — Llenar Toolbelt del Otro
activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.student_a_handout: Has 10 definitions + 10 empty word slots. Has 10 words WITHOUT definitions.
activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.student_b_handout: Has the OPPOSITE 10 definitions + 10 words WITHOUT definitions.
activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.instruction_en: A asks B: 'What is the definition of _____?' B gives definition. A writes it. Switch. No showing papers.
activity_e3_vocabulary_info_gap.instruction_es_cursiva: A pregunta a B: '¿Cuál es la definición de _____?' B da definición. A escribe. Intercambien. Sin mostrar papeles.

rotation_options_for_instructor.title_en: INSTRUCTOR ROTATION MENU — PM-2.5 Flow Options (within S2 part 2)
rotation_options_for_instructor.time_available: PM-2.5 tiene presupuesto de tiempo compartido con PM-2.3 dentro de S2. Recomendación: PM-2.5 ocupa 45-60 min de los 120 min directos de S2.

30 min → Archetype C (Reader's Theater + Cloze + Repeated Reading)
